missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Польза' stays in the nominative case as the feminine subject that exists. 'Большая' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Пользу' is the accusative direct object of 'приносит'. 'Огромную' is the agreeing feminine accusative adjective. A very common collocation.
Strategic focus: Genitive after quantity. 'Пользы' is the genitive form required after 'много'. 'От книги' adds the source of the benefit. A natural everyday pattern.
Strategic focus: Accusative in a set phrase. 'На пользу' is a fixed accusative expression meaning 'for the benefit of'. The noun follows 'на' in the accusative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О пользе' uses the prepositional form 'пользе' after 'о' to express talking about the benefit. A useful discussion pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Пользе' is the dative form after 'благодаря', which always governs the dative to express cause or thanks.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of respect. 'Пользой' is the instrumental case showing in what respect the vitamins are useful. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Genitive with preposition. 'Пользы' is the genitive form after 'без' to express the absence of benefit. 'Всякой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Nominative in a question. 'Польза' is nominative as the subject of the question. 'Какая' agrees in the feminine nominative, asking about the benefit gained.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Польза' is nominative as the subject. 'Очевидна' is the short feminine predicate adjective agreeing with it. A clean descriptive model.
